targets.summary: Remove the vendored kineto repo-level files (code of conduct, contributing, lint, and clang config files) because the core PyTorch versions take over and these won't apply or run any more.
targets.adoption_evidence: Before: the commented line was "# Code of Conduct" (line 1 of third_party/kineto/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). After: the whole file was deleted ("deleted file mode 100644", "+++ /dev/null"), so the line has no merged version. Removing the vendored code of conduct is exactly what the maintainer asked for.
targets.stage3_reason: The merged diff deletes `third_party/kineto/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, so the request was adopted. But removing a duplicate `# Code of Conduct` from a vendored subtree is housekeeping. It isn't a defect or design problem in the code, so it's not a fair recall target.
